title: DR1's declaration says responsibility for the consignment starts at submission and runs until entry into Great Britain, then lists the two ways it ends; the frontend compresses this into one sentence and never says when responsibility starts.

controls.text: I confirm I am responsible for this consignment until it has cleared border control checks or reached the place of destination.

finding.frontend: The whole second clause is one heading: "I confirm I am responsible for this consignment until it has cleared border control checks or reached the place of destination." (`src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/declaration/copy/copy.en.js:5-6`). It says when responsibility ends but never says when it begins, and it runs the two end conditions together in a single sentence so that neither is easy to read on its own.
finding.prototype: DR1 separates the clause from its terms. The heading is short — "I confirm I am responsible for this consignment." — and under it a sentence states the period: "I am responsible from the submission of this notification to when it enters Great Britain. And I am responsible until it has either:", followed by two bullets, "cleared official checks at the border" and "reached the Place of Destination as stated on the health certificate or notification" (`app/views/declaration.html:46-51`). Two things the frontend does not say are stated here: that responsibility begins at submission, and that the place of destination is the one named on the health certificate or the notification rather than any place of destination.
finding.difference: Rewrite the second clause to DR1's shape — a short heading, a paragraph stating the period, and the two end conditions as a bulleted list. The copy file needs the heading shortened, a new key for the period sentence and an array for the two bullets; the template renders one heading here today and needs a heading, a paragraph and a list. Legal text on a legal page: take DR1's wording unchanged, and add the Welsh equivalents.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding the statement that responsibility runs from the submission of the notification anywhere on the frontend's declaration page.

relatedTo.why: Both are clauses of the same declaration and both need the same legal sign-off before the copy changes.
